name: PxROM / MMC2

components.role: Nintendo MMC2 package with PRG/CHR bank latches, PPU-address tile-trigger latches and mirroring control

connections: PPU A0..A13 + RD -> mapper tile-trigger decode
notes: Mapper 9 / PxROM is replaceable external hardware. CPU $8000-$9FFF is one switchable 8 KiB PRG window followed by three fixed-last 8 KiB windows. The two 4 KiB CHR windows each select between FD/FE bank registers, with MMC2-specific PPU address reads clocking the package latch after the current CHR read. Mirroring is live mapper state; there is no PRG RAM, CHR RAM, IRQ or CPU/ROM bus conflict.
